name: Baduchin
summary: Baduchin, the thrilling Gorilla Tag fan game, is a captivating fusion of tag, horror, and rising lava elements, set against the backdrop of an eerie forest map. This adrenaline-pumping experience takes inspiration from the agile and mischievous capuchin monkeys, injecting an extra layer of excitement into the virtual world.
